selection: All 3 previously registered Southern Hemisphere original GPS source manifests plus the independent, already registered Kruger elephant original. No outcome sign or source effect sizes used to add/remove a study.
justification: Original-data macro ecological habitat/region contrast across hemispheres; the northern 5-source result already exposed, but southern solar-azimuth outcome not opened at this freeze point.
scope: Exploratory comparative original-GPS cohort patterns, NOT untouched independent validation, NOT independent source-wide sampling of all 259 GPS/GNSS packages.
qualification: Original source MD5, bitstream UUID and bytes must match. One actual source GPS fix per individual UTC hour chosen nearest clock-hour start by timestamp only, then the original unchanged 0.5-2h, 0.1 km and sun >10 degree qualification, animal >=30 steps >=5 solar dates.
primary_outputs: Solar relative compass and clock conditioned circular covariance per source taxon; present missingness and individual bootstrap intervals without cherry picking. All 4 archives mandatory in output.
independence: Etosha elephant and jackal share a landscape (not independent ecosystems). Kruger elephants from different region/years. Brazil tapirs represent third region. Multiple original archives do not automatically supply independent populations if deployments overlap.
privacy: Do not redistribute or log animal-level GPS data, individual identifiers, timestamp arrays, tracks or precise locations. Aggregated source taxon reports and provenance only.
